title: Laura & Gary · Greece 2027
eyebrow: Suites With Keith · Your honeymoon, Laura & Gary
meta: September 22 to October 8, 2027 · Two travelers · Sixteen nights
intro: Three nights in Athens, four at Vione on Paros, a private boat across to Sifnos for five nights at Verina Astra, then four on the caldera at Kapari to finish. All four stays are booked, and a car is waiting on Paros and Sifnos.
route_note: Vione and Verina Astra are booked through Fora; the Grand Hyatt and Kapari are booked on your points. Drivers meet you at every island airport and port.
days_intro: Everything on the ground and on the water is arranged through Original Senses, my partner in Athens. Your own time is the rest of it.

days.title: Arrive Athens
days.note: Three nights at the Grand Hyatt for the Acropolis, the Plaka and long dinners.

days.title: Fly to Paros
days.note: A driver meets you at Paros airport and takes you to Vione. Your car is delivered to the hotel.

days.title: Vione, four nights
days.note: A sea-view suite with its own plunge pool, Naoussa evenings and a car to explore the island.

days.title: Paros to Sifnos by private boat
days.note: A full day on a private RIB via Antiparos, with swim stops and a Greek picnic. Your luggage comes with you and you step off on Sifnos. A second car is waiting at Verina Astra.

days.title: Verina Astra, five nights
days.note: The island the Greeks go to for food, quiet coves and village walks.

days.title: Hands-on cooking in a Sifnian house
days.note: With a local cook, then the full meal with Greek wine.

days.title: Ferry to Santorini
days.note: A driver to Sifnos port, the ferry south, and a driver up to Kapari. Being priced now.

days.title: Kapari, four nights
days.note: An indoor hot tub and the caldera out the window to finish.

days.title: Fly home
days.note: A driver from Kapari to Santorini airport.

stays.headline: Grand Hyatt Athens, three nights in the city
paras: Three nights is the right amount of Athens: the Acropolis early before the heat and the crowds, the Plaka and Anafiotika in the afternoon, and long dinners after.
Booked on your points, and an easy run to the airport for the short flight to Paros.

img.caption: Vione, on the low cliffs at Ambelas

stays.headline: Vione, quiet design and your own plunge pool
paras: Vione is the kind of hotel that quietly impresses you. Clean architecture, understated interiors and a calm, adults-focused feel, with every detail considered.
It sits just outside Naoussa, so dinner in the old port is ten minutes away, and with the car you have the beaches on the east coast and the hill villages of Lefkes and Marpissa.

card.label: Your suite · 4 nights
rows: Junior Suite, sea view, private plunge pool

img.caption: Verina Astra, on the cliff at Poulati above Kastro

stays.headline: Verina Astra, a cliff over the Aegean
paras: The most romantic stay on Sifnos: a handful of suites on the cliff at Poulati, with Kastro on foot and Bostani, the hotel's farm-to-table restaurant, for your dress-up dinner.
Sifnos is the island where Greece slows down. Days are about long lunches, pottery villages and swimming at quiet coves, and with the car you can reach all of them.

stays.headline: Kapari, the caldera to finish
paras: Four nights on the caldera at Kapari Natural Resort, with an indoor hot tub in your room and the view straight out over the water.
After nine quiet island nights, Santorini is the postcard: sunsets from the terrace, and a slow last few days before the flight home.
